text: At period 27, on the sculpture's table, each known letter forces the key letter in its slot (place p uses slot p mod 27); three slots stay free.
A 27 to 29 letter key is unlikely to be one word, so the experiment built 272 keys from the puzzle's words: two joined, joined with an X or a Q, a word and its mirror, a word doubled.
9,716,112 trials over every shaped key, 63 x 63 tables, three modes and three key readings: none comes within three misses of the forced letters.
